description: Build the complete theme system, shared UI components, and global context providers that all screens will use. This includes a ThemeContext with dark/light modes, a shared color palette and typography system, reusable glassmorphism card components, gradient backgrounds, and a SettingsContext for app-wide preferences (theme, haptics, sounds).
steps: Create src/styles/theme.js with a comprehensive theme object containing: colors (primary palette with teal/purple gradients for dark mode, warm light palette for light mode), typography (font sizes, weights, letter spacing), spacing scale, border radii, shadow definitions, gradient presets
Create src/contexts/ThemeContext.jsx with a ThemeProvider that: reads saved theme preference from AsyncStorage, provides theme object and toggleTheme function, applies system color scheme as default

Create src/contexts/SettingsContext.jsx with a SettingsProvider that: manages haptics enabled/disabled, sound enabled/disabled, daily reminder time, session duration preferences - all persisted to AsyncStorage

Create src/contexts/SessionContext.jsx with a SessionProvider that: tracks session history (date, duration, pattern, completed), calculates streaks (current and longest), stores achievements/milestones, provides addSession/getStats functions - all persisted to AsyncStorage
Create src/components/ui/GlassCard.jsx - a reusable glassmorphism card with blur background, subtle border, and shadow
Create src/components/ui/GradientBackground.jsx - a full-screen animated gradient background component with particle effects (floating orbs that drift slowly)
Create src/components/ui/AnimatedButton.jsx - a pressable button with scale animation on press and optional haptic feedback
Create src/components/ui/ProgressRing.jsx - a circular SVG progress indicator for session progress and stats
Create src/components/ui/Typography.jsx - Text wrapper components (Heading, Subheading, Body, Caption) that use theme typography
Update app/_layout.jsx to wrap the app with ThemeProvider, SettingsProvider, and SessionContext providers
acceptance_criteria: ThemeContext provides dark and light theme objects with toggle functionality
SessionContext can store and retrieve session history
All UI components render without errors
The app compiles with all new providers and components
verification: Run npx expo export --platform web and confirm exit code 0
findings: All files created and verified with expo export --platform web (exit code 0). GlassCard uses a try/require pattern for expo-blur with fallback to semi-transparent View on web. ProgressRing uses Animated.createAnimatedComponent for SVG circle animation. AnimatedButton uses Haptics.impactAsync wrapped in try/catch since haptics are not available on web. Not committed per feature plan - commit deferred to FEAT-004.
